repository.note: Round 102 implementation was already in progress. The observation did not change Cargo, Freight, Figma, a public deployment, or protected gold evidence.

root_cause.classification: incorrect landmark element and missing accessible names
root_cause.conclusion: The shared expanded primary link group used aside.mms-rail, so its visible desktop representation exposed a complementary landmark instead of navigation. The compact nav used the correct element but neither responsive variant had an accessible name.

rejected_alternatives: aside role=navigation because the role is not allowed on aside
a nested nav inside aside because it preserves a redundant complementary landmark
selected_implementation.zero_visual_change_basis: All style and runtime selectors are class-based. Replacing only the element and adding aria-label preserved computed display, position, padding, z-index, and bounding geometry in the observed matrix.

protected_behavior: No CSS, media, river, control-panel, WTW, Withered Green, embed, or route behavior changes.
No Cargo, Freight, Figma, deployment, publication, or protected-gold changes.

negative_controls: primary navigation nested in complementary role
primary navigation nested in generic nav
primary navigation nested in navigation role
both responsive navigation variants forced visible

limitations: Repository Chromium does not certify a future Cargo serialization or assistive-technology session.
The hidden responsive variant remains in the DOM but is display:none and absent from the accessibility tree.
A later Cargo activation requires separate complete-save and reload-persistence verification.
